queries.query: Sandakan Malaysia official cadastral map parcel land registry Sabah JUPEM eKadaster
queries.result: Official sources identify Sabah's Lands and Surveys Department (JTU) as the state land and survey custodian. JTU lists JTUWMA Pro as a registered-user system for geometrical cadastral information; no anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was verified.

queries.query: Sandakan Sabah peta kadaster rasmi lot tanah JUPEM pejabat tanah
queries.result: Official Malay-language JTU material names Pejabat Juruukur Daerah Sandakan and Pejabat Penolong Pemungut Hasil Tanah Sandakan. JTUWMA Pro is described as requiring registered-user access; no anonymous safe parcel geometry response was verified.

registry.custodian: Jabatan Tanah dan Ukur Negeri Sabah (Lands and Surveys Department Sabah)
registry.localOffice: Pejabat Juruukur Daerah Sandakan / Office of District Surveyor Sandakan
registry.localOfficeAddress: Bangunan Urusetia Negeri Sabah, Batu 7, Jalan Labuk, 90000 Sandakan
registry.sourceScope: State land and survey administration; the official site also lists a Sandakan district survey office and cadastral-related services.
registry.geometryAccess: JTUWMA Pro advertises land parcel information and geometrical cadastral information but presents a sign-in page; no credentials were used.

geometry.exactWupPointTest: No anonymous parcel feature query was available from the reviewed first-party routes. The exact WUP point was not used as evidence of absence.

runtimeReadiness.reason: A real local registry custodian was verified, but no anonymous safe-ID geometry response and no independently qualified adapter were found.
